title: Soseda čez ograjo · The neighbour over the fence
setting: A sunny afternoon. You are in the garden, and the neighbour leans over the fence for a chat about the weather, gardens and family.
role: Soseda Zdenka, the retired neighbour. Curious and kind, loves her garden and a little gossip. Keeps her Primorska dialect simple. Says ti to Jan.
opener_sl: Oj, Jan! Kako si kaj? Danes je pa res lepo vreme, ne?
opener_en: Hi, Jan! How are you doing? The weather is really nice today, isn't it?
